title: Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry, Painting Appearance
synopsis: Marionette is a world model for interactive games that explicitly predicts a 3D world state (including articulated skeletons and trajectories) and uses a zero-parameter renderer to compute geometry and occlusion before a diffusion model synthesizes the photorealistic appearance from this structured state.

title: Split the Labor: Separating Evidence Interpretation from Decision Aggregation
synopsis: The paper proposes separating evidence interpretation from decision aggregation by defining a structured evidence tuple (hypothesis, reliability, rationale, provenance) and showing that combining interpretations should use calibrated log-likelihood ratios rather than simple summation, which avoids count-scale drift.

title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
synopsis: Rollplex is a runtime that improves the efficiency of Vision-Language Model post-training by overlapping the prefix computation (which is independent of the generated response) with the rollout decoding phase to maximize GPU utilization.

title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
synopsis: The Twin system is a test-time world-model inference method that automatically constructs an executable world model for unknown, continual learning tasks by simulating interactions and using discrepancies as signals to repair the model.

title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model
synopsis: YOPO is a method that integrates conditional steering (to guide reasoning) and zero-shot sufficiency detection (to abstain when information is lacking) into a single forward pass of a frozen language model backbone.

title: GhostPoint: Self-Supervised Representation Learning by Hallucinating Occluded LiDAR Structure
synopsis: GhostPoint is an SSL framework for 3D object detection that generates and trains on 'hallucinated' latent features for occluded regions by introducing a predictor-level supervision scheme using instance voxel dilation.

title: Generation-Powered Inference for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
synopsis: This framework, Generation-Powered Inference (GPI), proposes using generative models to improve statistical inference on distribution-valued outcomes by transforming the problem into estimating a mean function in a Hilbert space.

title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
synopsis: This work provides a theory and method for deciding what state needs to be retained when continuing a task with a large language model across separate sessions, formulating it as transferring the in-context learning state.

title: Participatory Moral AI Is Not Neutral: The Invisible Hand of Developers
synopsis: This paper analyzes the process of 'moral preference elicitation' for training AI policies, showing how developer choices in feature scoping, voter sampling, and question framing fundamentally shape the resulting moral preferences, even when using aggregated voting data.

title: RecipeNet: A Hierarchical Transformer for Recipe Data
synopsis: RecipeNet is a hierarchical Transformer architecture designed to process structured procedural data like recipes, capturing both field-level interactions within steps and sequential dependencies across steps.

title: Universal Thermodynamic Interatomic Potentials for Crystalline Materials
synopsis: This work introduces a Thermodynamic Interatomic Potential (TIP) that extends standard interatomic potentials to model Gibbs free energy, allowing for finite-temperature calculations of crystal phase stability and phase transitions using automatic differentiation.

title: Generating Benchmark Health Data Using a Tabular Diffusion Transformer
synopsis: A two-stage framework uses a diffusion transformer to generate synthetic cross-tabular datasets by first transforming heterogeneous raw tables into standardized statistical representations, which are then used to train the generator.

title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters
synopsis: This paper adapts the Muon optimizer for low-rank parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) by linearizing and solving a relaxed Muon objective using least-squares, resulting in an efficient method called sMuon.

title: Ensuring Safe Physical AI in Urban Mobility via Hazard-Informed Synthesized Envelopes
synopsis: The framework combines systematic hazard analysis with runtime enforcement to create cross-layer safety envelopes for robotic systems operating in complex urban environments.

title: LP-NAS: Linear Programming-based Neural Architecture Search
synopsis: LP-NAS proposes a framework for differentiable Neural Architecture Search by formulating a linear program that uses the validation-loss gradient and training-loss Hessian to derive an architecture update direction, resulting in faster convergence than standard DARTS methods.

title: Expected Free Energy-based Informative Path Planning for Robotic Mars Exploration
synopsis: This work proposes using Expected Free Energy (EFE), derived from active inference, as a single objective function for robotic path planning to simultaneously manage information gain and travel costs when exploring unknown environments like Mars.

title: SheetCompass: Hierarchical Relation Graphs for Agentic Spreadsheet Reasoning
synopsis: SheetCompass is an agentic framework that improves spreadsheet reasoning for LLMs by explicitly modeling and utilizing the complex structural relationships and spatial context within and across multiple worksheets.

title: Designing Compact Neural Architectures via Neuron Gating and Mixed Activation
synopsis: This work proposes a general bilevel optimization framework to find compact neural architectures by using continuous relaxations for traditionally discrete decisions like neuron and activation choices, resulting in methods like NAS-NGMA.

title: PACE-Bench: Benchmarking Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution in Dynamic Environments
synopsis: PACE-Bench is a new simulator-grounded benchmark that tests self-evolving agents' ability to adapt their source code to a mutated target environment across six physics domains, requiring iterative design based on diagnostic feedback.

title: Style or Signature? Artist-Disjoint Evaluation of Style Classification in Frozen Vision Embeddings
synopsis: This work proposes an artist-disjoint evaluation protocol for style classification using frozen image embeddings, finding that style discrimination robustness varies significantly across historical movements depending on whether individual artists are held out during testing.

title: Designing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: A Unified Path-Space View
synopsis: This work unifies existing reinforcement learning approaches for diffusion models by showing that disparate losses—from reverse-trajectory and forward-matching methods—derive from a single path-space principle, leading to a unified, variance-reduced policy-gradient estimator.

title: Knowing When to Stop: Bayesian Optimal Stopping for LLM Evaluations
synopsis: optstop is a framework for LLM evaluation that adaptively allocates compute by treating evaluation as a sequential measurement problem, continuing sampling only where estimation uncertainty remains high.

title: More Correct Mass, Worse Answers: Why Power Sampling Can Fail and How to Fix It
synopsis: This work diagnoses a paradox where Power Sampling, a technique to improve reasoning by sharpening trajectory distributions, can actually degrade performance by causing dose and coverage mismatches, proposing a deformation-controlled target to fix this issue.

title: CytoBERT: A Foundation Model for Cytometry Data
synopsis: CytoBERT is an open-weight foundation model pretrained on a large, standardized corpus of single-cell cytometry data to learn transferable relationships between markers across heterogeneous datasets.

title: CRAFT: Constrained Reward via Attention Fine-Tuning for Subject Personalization without Composed Targets
synopsis: CRAFT is a framework that fine-tunes a reference-aware multimodal diffusion transformer using only 10K reference images and subject masks to achieve subject personalization, avoiding the need for costly composed-target supervision used by prior methods.

title: Offline Deep Q* Estimation with Diffusion Models
synopsis: This work proposes a framework using conditional diffusion models to estimate the reward law and transition kernel for offline RL, which then allows for the data-driven approximation of the optimal Bellman operator to estimate $Q^*$.

title: Whose doctor does the AI recommend? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in large language model-assisted physician choice
synopsis: This paper conducts a randomized audit across several LLMs, showing that physician choice recommendations are mainly driven by reputation scores and fees, while subtle, unmentioned demographic signals show measurable, consistent biases.

title: CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing
synopsis: CPI-Bench is a new benchmark for image editing that includes subsets for general tasks, practical real-user scenarios, and highly demanding reasoning-based editing to evaluate models beyond simple single-image operations.

title: MagnifiQ: Patch-aware Text Guided Progressive Upscaling for High-Resolution Image Restoration
synopsis: MagnifiQ is an image restoration framework that progressively upscales and restores images by replacing diffusion model self-attention layers with convolutions and using patch-specific text prompts for localized guidance during upscaling to high resolutions like 4K.

title: Decoding the Past: An Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Framework for Sex Attribution in Prehistoric Hand Stencils
synopsis: This framework uses an uncertainty-aware deep learning pipeline, combining dual image processing, silhouette augmentation, and ensemble methods (EfficientNet-B3 and MobileViT-S), to attempt sex attribution from prehistoric hand stencils by modeling and aggregating prediction uncertainty.

title: Learning-to-Transition for Large-scale and High-Order MIMO Detection
synopsis: This work proposes a Learning-to-Transition (L2T) framework for high-order MIMO detection that models the process as a stochastic sequence of complete-vector transitions using a Transformer, and details a multi-stage training strategy for transferring hard-output policies to soft-output iterative detection receivers.

title: Optimal Scheduling of Road Maintenance Jobs Considering Impact on Traffic Flows
synopsis: This paper proposes using data-driven surrogate models to approximate equilibrium arc flows from origin-destination demand, aiming to make network maintenance planning computationally tractable for real-world traffic scheduling.

title: Information Satisfaction: A Reader-Centered Axis for Summarization Evaluation
synopsis: This work proposes evaluating summarization based on 'information satisfaction' relative to a user's background persona, finding that common metrics, including LLM-as-judge scores, fail to adequately measure this human-centric utility.

title: Shift Aware Transfer Learning with Adaptive Dual-Encoder Fusion for PM Forecasting in Data-Limited Environments
synopsis: This work proposes a shift-aware dual-encoder transfer framework to forecast PM2.5 when local data is limited and domain shifts occur, achieving state-of-the-art performance by adaptively fusing source-domain knowledge with target-specific representations.

title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports
synopsis: Wyvern is a multi-agent framework designed to automatically generate grounded, multimodal technical reports by integrating text, images, and tables while including a claims auto-revision stage.

title: The Dynamics of Intelligence Explosions
synopsis: This paper mathematically explores the dynamics of potential intelligence explosions in AI, focusing on growth rates and introducing generation time as a key parameter determining whether singular, rapid capability escalation is possible.

title: UMPIRE-Net: Unrolled Magnitude-Phase Regularization Network for Accelerated MRI
synopsis: UMPIRE-Net is a physics-driven deep learning method for MRI reconstruction that explicitly separates and regularizes the magnitude and phase components of complex images, improving results over standard complex-valued approaches.

title: Online Inference in Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning
synopsis: This work develops theoretical results proving the weak convergence of the Polyak--Ruppert averaged estimator and its bootstrap counterpart for various statistical functionals of the return distribution learned from a single Markov trajectory.

synopsis: This dataset contains anonymized raw agent traces from combined teams, structured for text generation tasks and available for conversion using the teich package.

title: FlyRank/internship-warehouse
synopsis: A large, pseudo-anonymized, star-schema dataset spanning 81.8 million rows, structured with hashed keys and containing historical data from multiple sources for advanced analysis.

title: histde/ddb-newspaper-corpus
synopsis: This is a large corpus of over 11 million pages of historical German newspapers from 1638 to 1964, containing 25.8 billion tokens of OCR fulltext.

title: finebooks/bhl-impact-gt
synopsis: This dataset contains 2,165 page scans from six historical natural-history books, providing expert transcriptions and full page-layout ground truth for evaluating OCR, text recognition, and document layout analysis on real historical print.

title: ropedia-ai/xperience-10m
synopsis: Xperience-10M is a large-scale egocentric, multimodal dataset containing human experience for embodied AI, robotics, world models, and spatial tasks, including video, depth, and audio modalities.

title: ACERobotics/ACE-Data-0
synopsis: This dataset aims to turn real home environments into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized recording studios for training embodied AI models across video, audio, and 3D modalities.

title: openbmb/Ultra-FineWeb
synopsis: Ultra-FineWeb is a large-scale, high-quality dataset built using an efficient verification pipeline applied to FineWeb and Chinese FineWeb sources for pretraining LLMs.

title: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb
synopsis: FineWeb is a large-scale dataset containing over 18.5 trillion tokens of cleaned and deduplicated English web data derived from CommonCrawl, optimized for LLM performance.

title: r0b0tlab/qwen3.8-max-glm5.2-kimi-k3-distillation
synopsis: A multi-teacher dataset compiled from traces of Qwen3.8-Max, GLM-5.2, and Kimi Code K3 covering diverse domains like code, math, and instruction-following, available in a deduplicated parquet format.

title: Anthropic/hh-rlhf
synopsis: This dataset contains human preference data regarding helpfulness and harmlessness from an RLHF process, intended for training reward models rather than for direct supervised fine-tuning of dialogue agents.

title: HuggingFaceCode/stack-v3-train
synopsis: This is the Stack v3, an open dataset of source code crawled from GitHub and designed for pre-training code LLMs with full-repository context.

title: r0b0tlab/qwen3.8-max-distillation-50k
synopsis: A curated dataset of nearly 50k teacher-generated traces from qwen3.8-max-preview, formatted for supervised fine-tuning and knowledge distillation.

title: HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k
synopsis: This is a smaller, filtered subset of the UltraChat dataset, initially composed of 1.4 million ChatGPT-generated dialogues, used for faster supervised fine-tuning of the Zephyr-7B-β model.

title: saidutta69/fable-5-premium
synopsis: This is a supervised fine-tuning dataset of 12,730 records built from Claude Fable-5 agent traces, available in parquet format.

title: openai/gsm8k
synopsis: GSM8K is a benchmark dataset containing 8.5K linguistically diverse grade school math word problems requiring multi-step reasoning involving basic arithmetic operations.

title: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu
synopsis: A newly released dataset called FineWeb-Edu contains 1.3 trillion tokens of educational web pages, filtered from the FineWeb dataset using a classifier trained with Llama-3-70B-Instruct annotations.

title: cais/hle
synopsis: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is a large, multi-modal benchmark containing 2,500 closed-ended questions across many subjects, intended as a comprehensive academic test.

title: fka/prompts.chat
synopsis: This is a dataset repository mirroring prompts.chat, a social platform where users share and collect AI prompts for various tasks like question-answering and text generation.

title: GokuScraper/seedance-2-prompts-datasets
synopsis: This is a large, open-source dataset containing over 50GB and 8100+ video generation prompts used with the Seedance-2 model, structured for AI video creators.

title: FINAL-Bench/AX-RAY
synopsis: AX-RAY is a catalog of 117 machine-readable AI safety diagnostic criteria that organizes model-intrinsic and deployment assessment items for use in model evaluation.

title: SWE-bench/SWE-bench_Verified
synopsis: SWE-bench Verified is a curated subset of 500 human-validated test cases from the SWE-bench dataset designed to evaluate systems' ability to automatically solve GitHub issues using unit test verification against a pull request.

title: CaptiveDreamer/CaraArchive
synopsis: This dataset is an index containing 3.43 million posts with metadata and links to the Cara App's CDN, but it contains no actual image data for training.

title: ai4bharat/MSMARCO-XI
synopsis: A collection of the MS MARCO dataset containing queries, passages, and answers translated into various Indic languages, suitable for machine reading comprehension tasks.

title: Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry, Painting Appearance
synopsis: Marionette is a world model for interactive games that predicts an explicit, 3D, multi-entity state (skeletons, trajectories, rotations) and uses a zero-parameter renderer to compute geometry before a video-diffusion model synthesizes the final photorealistic appearance from the structured control.

title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
synopsis: Second Thought is a training-free inference framework for LLM agents that concurrently runs four auxiliary reasoning branches during the action/observation idle window, merging the results back to the main loop to improve agent performance while reducing main thread decoding time.

title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
synopsis: SimpleOPD is a distillation technique that transfers reasoning capabilities from long-context teacher models to short-context student models by operating in a shared text space and aligning tokens based on identical text spans, while also introducing a student reference KL loss to manage excessive output length.

title: Dion3: Full-Stack Orthogonal Updates
synopsis: Dion3 is a revised optimizer building on Muon that reduces the computational overhead of orthogonalization via a Gram Newton-Schulz algorithm, accelerated kernels, and a modified update rule, achieving significant speedups while maintaining or improving performance.

title: UNMASK: Discovering and Causally Verifying Spurious Shortcuts in Text Classifiers
synopsis: UNMASK is an automated pipeline that discovers and causally verifies spurious surface patterns in text classifiers by generating executable boolean expressions from unlabeled examples and validating them via counterfactual interventions.

title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
synopsis: Mobius-v0 is a model architecture that decouples knowledge into a shared Memory (FFN) and separates reasoning into multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) to improve knowledge compression and reasoning efficiency.

title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
synopsis: MobileMem is a benchmark and framework for testing on-device, long-term memory for AI agents, built from a year's worth of diverse, multimodal mobile user experiences to test temporal reasoning and knowledge updating.

title: HumanTracker: Towards Comprehensive and Human-Aligned Motion Tracking Benchmark
synopsis: HumanTracker is a comprehensive motion tracking benchmark using 153 hours of humanoid trajectories to evaluate motion by diagnosing physical artifacts like foot skating, alongside a new metric called HumanScore trained on human preference data.

title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
synopsis: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation (S^2VOPD) constructs on-policy learning signals by creating an information asymmetry between the teacher's distribution (conditioned on the original image) and the student's distribution (conditioned on a strongly augmented view) to achieve performance gains without ground-truth data or a separate teacher model.

title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
synopsis: This paper introduces Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR), a training-free framework that analyzes reasoning traces by condensing them into decision-critical claims to test for falsification, showing improvements over standard self-consistency checks with fewer tokens.

title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
synopsis: The paper introduces forecast collapse, where time-series foundation models predict flat returns for many assets, and proposes a new objective function, CalibRank, to balance prediction calibration with cross-sectional ranking correlation.

title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
synopsis: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5 is a toolkit that processes robot rollout videos to derive fine-grained metrics for assessing embodied models, including metrics for failure-side progress and recovery.

title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
synopsis: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation (LOPD) is a method that makes the source of supervision for self-training end-to-end learnable by retrieving and composing relevant experiences into continuous latent tokens to condition a self-teacher.

title: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining
synopsis: This work investigates how to optimally repeat limited, high-quality domain data to counteract data dilution when training very large language models, suggesting that the optimal repetition count can be estimated using smaller proxy models.

title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
synopsis: MMDiff is a framework that trains multimodal Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to create feature-level interfaces for discovering and controlling behaviors within Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs). It allows users to identify features altered by multimodal training, detect causal features per-token, and steer or remove these features for targeted control.

title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
synopsis: This work introduces Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping (RLVR) in on-policy RL, showing that optimizing for a current objective can deplete the sample support for future, related objectives, which is demonstrated across mathematical reasoning and instruction following tasks.

title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
synopsis: LITTLELEARNER is a 5B-parameter language model trained on LITTLECURRICULUM, a curated 88B-token corpus of U.S. elementary school material that explicitly excludes knowledge above Grade 5, creating a controlled sandbox for studying knowledge acquisition.

title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations
synopsis: UniProbe is a lightweight, unified detector that builds a directed graph over image patches, query tokens, and generated tokens within a VLM's forward pass, using interleaved GNN, ViT, and GRU modules to detect token-level hallucinations.

title: SPARGen: Unifying Spatial Perception and Reasoning through Native Multimodal Generation
synopsis: SPARGen is a unified multimodal framework that treats 3D reconstruction, dense correspondence, and spatial reasoning as instruction-conditioned generation tasks, outputting structured and geometric fields as token sequences.

title: Generation as Auxiliary Supervision: Enhancing Visual Understanding at Zero Inference Overhead via Decoupled Embedding Prediction
synopsis: The GAS framework treats visual generation as an auxiliary supervision signal for representation learning by adapting Next Embedding Prediction within a decoupled Mixture-of-Transformers architecture to enhance visual understanding without adding inference overhead.

title: Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events? A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators and Social Dissemination
synopsis: The paper introduces RA-Bench, a benchmark dataset of 17,886 videos mixing real and AI-generated clips across ten social-risk categories to systematically evaluate the generalization capabilities of current video detection methods.

title: Beyond Final Scores: A Systematic Evaluation of Agents for Long-Horizon AI Research and Development
synopsis: This work systematically evaluates seven frontier AI agents across 36 long-horizon tasks using a new framework to measure in-run behavior, finding that current agents act more like engineering optimizers than truly autonomous researchers.

title: CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing
synopsis: CPI-Bench is a proposed benchmark designed to evaluate real-world image editing by covering three subsets: general tasks, high-frequency practical scenarios, and highly demanding reasoning-based editing.

title: SmolTalk-360M
synopsis: A 360M-parameter instruction-tuned language model released with open weights and a training recipe, trained on 40B tokens of filtered web and synthetic dialogue.

title: SmolTalk-7B
synopsis: A 7B-parameter instruction-tuned language model released with open weights and a training recipe, trained on 40B tokens of filtered web and synthetic dialogue.

title: I ran a 270M model on an ESP32 and it answers questions about my greenhouse
synopsis: A write-up of quantising a 270M-parameter model to 4 bits and running it on an ESP32-S3 with 8MB of PSRAM, getting roughly two tokens per second, with the sensor-query prompts that worked and the ones that did not.

title: I ran a 13B model on a workstation GPU and it answers questions about my greenhouse
synopsis: A write-up of quantising a 13B-parameter model to 4 bits and running it on a workstation GPU, getting roughly twenty tokens per second, with the sensor-query prompts that worked and the ones that did not.

title: Pretraining a 500M model to GPT-2-XL quality on a single 4090 in nine days
synopsis: The authors pretrain a 500M-parameter transformer on one consumer GPU in nine days, matching GPT-2-XL on standard benchmarks, and release the data pipeline, code, and checkpoints.

title: Pretraining a 50B model to GPT-4 quality on a 512-GPU cluster in nine days
synopsis: The authors pretrain a 50B-parameter transformer on a 512-GPU cluster in nine days, matching GPT-4 on standard benchmarks, and release the data pipeline, code, and checkpoints.

title: tinygrad-lm/rp2040-llm
synopsis: Runs a 15M-parameter character-level language model on an RP2040 microcontroller in 264KB of RAM, with the quantisation script and the flashing instructions.

title: bartowski/SmolTalk-360M-GGUF
synopsis: GGUF quantisations of SmolTalk-360M in Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, and Q8_0.

title: nanoformer/tiny-mini-micro-lm
synopsis: A compact and efficient language model for fast inference.

title: Qwen3-1.7B released with open weights
synopsis: A 1.7B-parameter language model released with open weights, benchmarks, and a chat template.

title: Edge-AI startup raises $80M to put sub-1B models on every phone
synopsis: The company announced a Series B led by a growth fund, and says its sub-billion-parameter models will ship on handsets next year.

title: A 200M model that plays checkers by self-play, with the engine and the endgame database
synopsis: A 200M-parameter network trained by self-play reaches expert strength at checkers on one GPU in a week; the engine, the weights, and the generated endgame database are released.
